summary: Forward-test scenarios for existing entry skills. These fixtures describe observable acceptance; automated package parity does not prove conversational execution.

public_brand_update_contract.source: app-mcp-server/mcp-tools/brand/schemas.ts and brand-update.tool.ts, GOOSE-3878 final public contract

scenarios.name: research finalizes its stored pack without a raw fact patch
scenarios.request: Make the next video for this brand; its research is not complete yet.
acceptance: Uses the existing research stored-pack workflow and finalizes with patch.finalize_research only; reads the finalized brand back.
Does not send positioning, audience, products or proofPoints through kit_patch; that public field accepts video_lab only.
If a verified pack is unavailable, uses typed agent proposals and does not claim they are approved or that research is complete.
reject: Sends a raw kit_patch with finalize_research
Claims pending research facts are canonical without acceptance

scenarios.name: known answers before a gap-only interview
scenarios.request: Interview me about my brand. Our buyers are new parents; night feeds make them exhausted. Never promise a cure. We prefer calm voices in videos. Then continue my pending launch-ad request.
acceptance: Reads brand context and saves the already supplied audience, pain, prohibited claim and video voice preference before asking a new question.
Uses user_correction with the exact user statement; deeper pain is insight, the prohibited claim is dont, and video voice is do.
Reads back saved fields and source=user learnings. Asks only missing founder origin, conviction or buying context, with the known answer recapped in the question.
Resumes the pending launch-ad request after capture or skip.

scenarios.name: an inference remains a proposal
scenarios.request: Based on my website, suggest a sharper audience and stronger video rules. I have not confirmed either.
acceptance: Uses agent_proposal with patch.knowledge.audience or merged instructions and rationale, preserving the existing logo instruction.
Shows proposed before/after values from the initial read and request, records returned proposal IDs, and explains app acceptance; canonical reads still show the prior audience and instructions.
Does not write inferred facts as user learnings or call a missing endpoint.
reject: Claims an unaccepted proposal is saved

scenarios.name: video examples persist without becoming brand assets
scenarios.request: Remember https://example.com/competitor-ad.mp4 for our video taste: I like its quiet voice and slow cuts, but dislike its flashing captions. Use our own footage in the next ad.
acceptance: Lists existing taste media, then registers kind=video with brand scope, video-taste/reference-only tags and user provenance metadata.
Saves the user's video likes as do and dislikes as dont; reads back media and learnings.
Builds a verified taste brief with the link and reasons. Keeps Video preference learnings out of required or forbidden dialogue. Uses only the brand's own footage.
reject: Copies the competitor's footage or claims
Asks what they like despite the supplied explanation

scenarios.name: resume, duplicate and failed-readback handling
scenarios.request: Remember that pronunciation we discussed: pronounce Acme as ak-mee. Also keep the video example already saved. Make only this current video shorter.
acceptance: Updates rule-1 rather than inserting another pronunciation rule; reuses taste-1.
Keeps the shorter duration in the current project brief rather than a durable brand rule.
Reports that persistence could not be verified after readback fails; does not claim saved.
reject: Creates a duplicate rule or media row
Saves shorter as a permanent rule
Claims verified persistence after a read error

scenarios.name: source gates and unsupported persistence remain honest
scenarios.request: Save my founder belief that customers sleep twice as well, and set a daily spend limit of 100. We do not have evidence or quote permission yet.
acceptance: Keeps the founder belief attributable and unapproved; does not turn it into evidence or public copy.
Does not encode a spend cap as a learning or guess a currency.
Clearly reports the missing operating-plan/evidence write surface and the unsaved items.
reject: Claims the spend cap is active
